description: This file defines an API endpoint handler for fetching event types, including validation, database queries, and response formatting.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch event types, applying filters based on user permissions and query parameters.

methods.name: extractUserIdsFromQuery
methods.description: Extracts user IDs from query parameters, ensuring only admins can query multiple users.

methods.name: defaultScheduleId
methods.description: Assigns default schedule IDs to event types lacking a scheduleId, based on user defaults.
